author: Rojava IC
title: Sleeper-Cell Report July 2026 – Global Coalition reports 0 confirmed ISIS attacks
content:
An ISIS flag was raised on a school building in al-Zubari, eastern Deir ez-Zor countryside




 




Key Points




– Six sleeper-cell attacks recorded by RIC, but the Global Coalition claims 0 attacks were officially claimed by ISIS




– One military personnel was killed, and a further five injured




– A minimum of seven alleged ISIS members were arrested




– A total of 36 civilians were injured, two killed




– An ISIS flag was raised on a school building in Deir ez-Zor




– 

Two Tunisian families linked to ISIS mercenaries repatriated from Roj camp




 




In-Depth




In July of 2026, RIC 

recorded six sleeper-cell attacks which some publications have attributed to ISIS, according to

 

North Press Agency

 one of these attacks was claimed by ISIS whereas the

 

Global Coalition

 

reported that July was the first month since the territorial defeat of ISIS in 2019, where they claimed 0 attacks. Also this month at least 7 members of ISIS cells were arrested.




On July 7, Bombings struck central Damascus near the Ministry of Tourism and the Four Seasons Hotel, during the visit of Macron the president of France to Syria. Ministry of Interior has attributed the attack to ISIS, the bombing resulted in the killing of one civilian and injury of 36.




On July 8, three attacks happened during the same day and the are believed to have been carried out by ISIS member
